value.description: Raw observation as measured, before any model is subtracted. Unit depends on detector_type: wspr -> dB (SNR), magnetometer -> nT (X component), ephemeris -> AU (heliocentric distance). See DETECTOR_UNITS in crosscorr_lib/analysis/residuals.py.

residual.description: Observation minus the prediction of the base model fitted for this detector_type. For ballistic this is the MixedLM residual of `value ~ charge_temp + mass + (1|range_id)`; for every other detector_type it is the OLS residual of `value ~ kp + dst + f107`; when no confounders are available the model is not estimated, residual_method is 'none' and residual equals value. This is the column consumed by cross_correlation, mfdfa, stationarity and surrogate.

residual_method.description: Which base model produced residual. 'none' means no model was estimated and residual is the raw value.

unit.description: Physical unit of value, e.g. dB, nT, AU. Taken from DETECTOR_UNITS in crosscorr_lib/analysis/residuals.py.

quality_flag.description: 0 = observation present and model fitted, 1 = observation missing (value is NaN) or the base model failed to fit (residual is NaN).

meta.description: Source-specific metadata as a JSON-encoded object, e.g. {"tx": "...", "band": "..."}. Stored as a string, not a nested object, so the pandas/parquet round-trip preserves it unchanged.
